tagline: Leading European healthcare REIT creating value through capital recycling
hero_kpi_rationale: The healthcare portfolio represents 77% of total assets, becoming the main driver of growth and Cofinimmo's differentiating strategy in Europe, progressively replacing office properties.

kpis.name: Healthcare portfolio share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of portfolio value invested in healthcare real estate.
kpis.description: The company has shifted toward healthcare since 2018, with net investments of €4.6 billion in this segment.
kpis.signal: Successful strategic transition to healthcare in Europe.

kpis.name: Core net result
kpis.explanation: Main result of the company, equivalent to EPRA earnings.
kpis.description: Result increasing despite divestments, supported by healthcare rental income.

kpis.name: Occupancy rate
kpis.description: High occupancy rate across the entire portfolio, particularly in healthcare.

kpis.name: Average lease term
kpis.explanation: Average remaining duration of lease contracts.
kpis.description: Long-term leases, often indexed to inflation, ensuring visibility.
kpis.signal: Long-term income visibility with inflation-linked agreements.

kpis.name: Debt to assets ratio
kpis.explanation: Debt level relative to asset value.
kpis.description: Low ratio enabling financing of new investments.
kpis.signal: Solid financial structure with low leverage.

kpis.name: Average cost of debt
kpis.explanation: Average interest rate paid on debt.
kpis.description: Low-cost debt in a high-rate environment.
kpis.signal: Very low borrowing cost despite elevated rate environment.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.signal: Stable dividend supported by rental income.

kpis.name: 2025 investment budget
kpis.description: Investment budget of €170 million in 2025, primarily in healthcare.
kpis.signal: Continued commitment to healthcare real estate expansion.

kpis.name: 2025 dividend outlook
kpis.description: Dividend adjusted to €5.20 in 2025 to support future growth.
kpis.signal: Dividend adjustment supporting medium-term growth strategy.

ai_positioning.summary: Cofinimmo does not mention any strategy or initiatives related to artificial intelligence in recent documents. The company focuses on traditional real estate management and sustainability.
evidence: No mention of AI in 2024 roadshow presentation
No references to predictive analytics or AI-based automation tools
Priority given to sustainability and asset management
